description:
We are MindWave — young minds riding the wave of sound and science.

The Earth Information Jukebox challenge: turning NASA's Earth data into music that anyone can hear, feel, and understand.

Let's turn data into sound together! 🌍🎶
summary: Earth Jukebox is an interactive, accessible web platform that translates NASA Earth observation data into immersive music. By mapping specific colors in NASA satellite visualizations to musical instruments (Red = Bass, Blue = Cello, etc.), we turn complex climate data into something you can hear. Built primarily for the 300+ million blind and low-vision people worldwide, the platform also serves auditory learners, people with dyslexia, and children. Users can hear the urgency of climate change, explore live weather sonification for any city, and interact with an AI chatbot ("Spirit of Earth") powered by Gemini. Accessible by design, useful for everyone.
details:
Earth Jukebox is a web-based platform designed to make NASA's Earth observation data accessible through sound. Climate data is typically presented as complex heatmaps and animations, which are inaccessible to blind and low-vision individuals, and difficult for auditory learners or people with dyslexia to process. Our platform bridges this gap by converting the colors in NASA satellite imagery into distinct musical instruments.

How it works:

We use a Python pipeline (OpenCV, music21, FluidSynth) to analyze NASA GMAO videos offline. The algorithm extracts the percentage of 7 key colors in every frame and maps them to MIDI instruments (Red→Bass, Orange→Piano, Yellow→Strings, Green→Flute, Blue→Cello, Purple→Synth, White→Bells). FluidSynth renders the MIDI into audio, and FFmpeg syncs it with the original video. The frontend (React + Vite) hosts these sonified videos and provides interactive features.

Key Benefits & Impact:

- Accessibility: Makes complex climate data perceivable through sound for 300+ million blind/low-vision users.

- Education: Helps auditory learners, dyslexic students, and children grasp abstract climate concepts.

- Real-time Interaction: "Live City Sonification" fetches real weather data (Open-Meteo) and plays it as music instantly.

- AI Integration: The "Spirit of Earth" chatbot (Gemini API) answers climate questions in a friendly, accessible persona.

- Transparency: We include a "Visual Frames" gallery and detailed text descriptions for every dataset.

Tools & Technologies:

- Frontend: React 18, Vite, Tailwind CSS 4, Framer Motion, Recharts, React-Leaflet.

- Backend: Netlify Functions (Serverless Node.js).

- AI: Google Gemini API (with a 3-model fallback loop).

- Data Processing: Python (OpenCV for HSV color analysis, music21, FluidSynth, FFmpeg).

- Testing: Vitest (15 unit/integration tests), k6 (load testing).

Creativity:

We combined computer vision (color analysis) with music theory (MIDI synthesis) to create an entirely new way of experiencing climate data. The pixel-art "Spirit of Earth" character and the "Guess the Instrument" mini-game make the experience engaging for younger audiences.

Team Considerations:

We prioritized accessibility at every step: ARIA labels, `aria-live` regions, Web Speech API for audio guides, and haptic feedback on mobile. We also designed a fallback system for the AI chatbot (3 models) and for weather data (latitude-based estimation) to ensure the demo never fails.

Live Website: https://earth-jukebox.netlify.app

GitHub Repository: https://github.com/winlu2303/earth-jukebox

Demo Video: https://youtu.be/jyYzB4xJFCs
